item.text:
As of **22 November 2026**, use **OWASP ASVS 5.0.0** for a production checklist. OWASP lists it as the latest stable release and gives its publication date as **30 May 2025**. The Downloads page labels it “Stable Release 5.0.0” and offers an English CSV for checklist use. The GitHub release tag is `v5.0.0_release`. [OWASP Downloads](https://asvs.owasp.org/downloads/) · [OWASP publication date](https://asvs.owasp.org/) · [Tagged 5.0.0 release](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases/tag/v5.0.0_release)

GitHub’s **“Latest”** badge points to **“Bleeding Edge,”** an automated build from the `master` branch. The release page showed a generation time of **22 November 2026 at 13:25:24 UTC**. Its notes reserve that build for testing and preview and explicitly direct production users to **v5.0.0**. [OWASP GitHub Releases](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases)
